_comments.scope: Paths are relative to the storefront package root (the composed build directory root). Globs match per path segment: '*' and '?' never cross '/', '**' as a whole segment matches zero or more segments, '[' ']' are literal (route dirs like [...slug]).
_comments.layers: Each path belongs to at most one layer. A path matching two layers (or a layer and an assetException of another layer) is an error. 'exclude' removes a path from the layer it is listed under, it never assigns it to another one.
_comments.unclassified: A path matching no layer is unclassified: base-only today (see the A14 report), rejected as an overlay path by check-imports until it is listed here.
_comments.baseL2Enforcement: report until A13 moves every orchestration call behind ~/platform/*, then set to block (plan A14).
_comments.trustModel: Brand code is reviewed owner code. The import and shape rules stop accidental coupling (writable props, live stores, context lookup, QRL introspection, HTML or script insertion); they are not a sandbox against deliberately hostile JavaScript.
_comments.transitiveL1Allow: Reviewed pure L1 files a reached base L2 file may import, listed one by one (never a directory: src/utils/** holds the API adapter). They are walked like any other reached file, so a re-export of an adapter, a forbidden package or a context symbol inside them is still import-l1-transitive. Any other non-public L1 file reached from an overlay file is import-l1-transitive.
_comments.transitivePackagesAllow: Third-party packages a reached base file may import besides the framework packages (those get the r2 name check).
_comments.payments: src/components/payment, checkout and cart are L1 and not ejectable (plan A11 item 4, A8 refreshCartStock callers).
_comments.gateway: Brand views gateway (docs/plans/2026-10-11-brand-views-gateway.md, scripts/check-gateway.mjs): the only L1 access to presentation implementations (L2/L3 modules and the slot lookup) is gateway.dir. Every other non-presentation file may import them type-only. Inside gateway.dir a raw binding may only be an argument of a gateway.factories call; the slot lookup is imported only by gateway.slotLookupImporters; an action handle literal is built only in gateway.actionModule. modal is L1 because it frames interactive L1 markup (children never cross the gateway).

assetExceptions.reason: Required at this exact URL (sites.md: Sezzle assets); referenced by absolute string from the PDP widget and the checkout Sezzle component.
Required at this exact URL (sites.md: Sezzle assets). Not present in the SellRight base today; Damned supplies it.

deploy._comment: Brand deploy files (brand.json deployFiles) that are not storefront source. A file is exempt from the overlay import, shape and executable-asset rules only when it is a declared deploy file, sits in no layer and matches one of these globs (check-imports.mjs deployExemption). operationalScripts: build and process files run by Node, the shell or pm2, never bundled (Node built-ins allowed). publicScripts: public files a browser fetches by a fixed URL that a live brand must keep answering: the iOS privacy worker (an installed registration re-fetches it; the brand's copy retires itself) and the legacy analytics loader (cached pages still reference it).

_comments.mode: warn until plan A20 clears the base, then block. Overridable with --mode.
_comments.vendorUiAllowFiles: Files that may name a vendor: the provider label map (src/platform/payments/labels.ts) and the env key list (src/env.ts, a configuration identifier, not UI). Only the vendor-ui rule is skipped there.
_comments.scope: Base files only: every src file that is not L3 (layers.json), not a test, and not listed in .compose-overlay-files.txt (brand-owned). Fonts: 'Inter' is the base default and is not a brand font.
